panels.is: T1 Barcelona, dusk: the calm march seen from behind from a balcony, keys rising in a wave; a hooded figure flicks a string of fireworks toward the thin police line by a burning container
T1: three small firework bursts pop over the police line; the crowd turns its heads
T1: the police line has stepped one pace forward; thin tear-gas haze drifts through the keys
T2 Frankfurt gun store at night: hooded runners arrive; two haul the steel shutter up with a red crowbar; one swings a ripped-up give-way road sign at the glass
T2: the glass has gone, shards falling and glinting, two slide in through the gap, an A-board kicked over; young crowd on the near pavement with signs and phones
T2: blue police light sweeps from the right, everything turns blue, the group frozen mid-swing, crowd holds signs up
T3 Paris, Place de la Republique by day, low angle: black-clad front line throwing paving stones at two rows of riot police; burning car left, burning rental bikes, tricolours, Marianne above
T3: a tear-gas canister has landed; white gas swells over the lower half of Marianne's monument
T3: a water cannon truck from the right sweeps a jet across the front line; the crowd breaks and runs out left
T4 Tirana at dusk: two mopeds race in bottom-left, the passenger has fired an RPG, its smoke trail climbing to a police helicopter; the Ministry of Education burning; shield line mid-right
T4: the helicopter hit, spinning down trailing fire behind the ministry; the crowd slams into the shields
T4: the shield line broken, a melee of rioters and officers; two Molotovs burst in the bank windows (left)
T4 final hold: a fireball rises behind the ministry and backlights the melee; tear gas and flares
